# Is this for you? {#sec-is-this-for-you}

To help manage expectations and develop the material for this workshop,
we make a few assumptions about *who you are* as a participant in the
workshop.

We assume you can relate to one or more of the following:

- Have intermediate R coding skills
- Are familiar with the tidyverse framework
- Know ggplot2 syntax
- are interested in sharing your data or analysis methods through
  interactive application

While we have these assumptions to help focus the content of the
workshop, if you have an interest in the workshop but don't fit any of
the assumptions, *you are still welcome to attend*! We welcome everyone
until capacity has been reached.

In addition to the assumptions above, the workshop also has a fairly
focused scope, which may also help you decide if this workshop is for
you:

- Get a basic introduction to making apps in R
- Learn how to make interfaces with bslib
- Build a modularized app in Shiny
- Learn about the parquet file format
- Make your graphs interactive with plotly
